title: Applied cybersecurity challenges with SENSAI
summary: Learners solve browser-based Linux cybersecurity challenges that culminate in reading a protected flag. SENSAI observes active terminals and files and provides Socratic, context-sensitive guidance while withholding direct solutions.

sources.title: SENSAI: Large Language Models as Applied Cybersecurity Tutors
sources.evidence_quote: demonstrate and deepen their understanding ... by solving a series of applied educational challenges

context.learner_level: university students and global online learners

assessment.summary: Complete progressively difficult applied cybersecurity challenge modules.
student_actions: Investigate and exploit challenge programs in a Linux environment.
Ask SENSAI for contextual guidance when stuck.

student_role.description: GPT-4o used terminal and file context to guide problem solving without direct answers or hidden solution context.

grading.method: Challenge completion was demonstrated by obtaining flags; university course stakes were not fully reported.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 2,742 learners exchanged 178,074 messages across 15,413 sessions; active context was associated with faster challenge completion.
